title: Tokyo stocks surge for second straight session, Nikkei rises 1,211 points on renewed buying in AI and semiconductor shares
html:
The Nikkei Stock Average posted a sharp second straight gain on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Nov. 27, as fresh buying flowed into AI and chip stocks, lifting the benchmark back above the 58,000-point mark for the first time in three sessions.

At the close, the Nikkei Stock Average stood at 58,711.11, up 1,211.95 points from the prior day. Trading volume on the Prime Market was about 2.4 billion shares, while turnover hit roughly 7.79 trillion yen. Advancing issues numbered 926, while decliners totaled 582, with 41 stocks unchanged.

U.S. stock markets were shut the prior day for Thanksgiving, but European markets posted gains, with Germany's DAX and the UK's FTSE 100 both rising. Taking cues from those moves, Tokyo trading saw broad buying, notably in tech shares including AI and chip stocks, driving the Nikkei to a sharp second straight rise. Early in the session, the index briefly dipped into negative territory, but rebounded after early selling cooled, with the gain topping 1,000 points in the afternoon. A sharp rise in E-mini Nasdaq 100 futures also gave a lift. Short-term traders, mainly via futures, appeared to have driven the broader market higher. About 59% of Prime Market stocks rose. By sector, nonferrous metals, electrical equipment, and machinery posted gains, while non-AI sectors such as retail, land transport, and services were soft.

Among individual stocks, Kioxia Holdings Corporation <285A>, ADVANTEST CORPORATION <6857>, and SoftBank Group Corp. <9984> rose, while Lasertec corporation <6920>, Tokyo Electron Limited <8035>, and DISCO CORPORATION <6146> drew buying. TAIYO YUDEN CO., LTD. <6976>, IBIDEN CO.,LTD. <4062>, and Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. <5801> surged sharply, while Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. <8306>, Hitachi, Ltd. <6501>, and Mitsubishi Corporation <8058> traded firmly. Defense stocks including Mitsubishi Heavy Industries,Ltd. <7011>, Kawasaki Heavy Industries,Ltd. <7012>, and IHI Corporation <7013> moved higher, and JAPAN TOBACCO INC. <2914> also gained.

On the downside, FAST RETAILING CO., LTD. <9983>, Recruit Holdings Co.,Ltd. <6098>, and Nintendo Co., Ltd. <7974> fell, while DAIKIN INDUSTRIES, LTD. <6367>, Hankyu Hanshin Holdings,Inc. <9042>, ASICS Corporation <7936>, and ORIENTAL LAND CO.,LTD. <4661> declined. BANDAI NAMCO Holdings Inc. <7832> and SECOM CO., LTD. <9735> were also weak.

Source: MINKABU PRESS
